verdict.rationale: Vendor docs describe the dot as an always-on cloud agent with its own computer and browser that keeps working while your computer is off. It uses background agents to work in parallel, delegates to ChatGPT Work or Codex with an Activity view for inspecting that work, and reaches out with results or prepared fixes for your review. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that autonomous background tasks complete reliably and return for review as documented.
